description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the application's database and credentials from Oracle to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including photo storage and database access.
tasks.reason: The application uses Oracle-specific database features and plaintext credentials. Azure Database for PostgreSQL provides the target managed relational database, and Managed Identity replaces plaintext database authentication.
tasks.requirements: Migrate database access, schema definitions, and Oracle-specific SQL to Azure Database for PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents. Convert photo storage from Oracle BLOB to PostgreSQL bytea. Replace plaintext database credentials with Managed Identity authentication.
